primary.why: Windows, Windows Apps, Xbox One, Xbox Series, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 releases exist. Focus/Mundfish later released Blood on Crystal and the Ultimate Edition as the complete package with the Atomic Pass DLCs, so the archive route is the Windows Ultimate Edition for the highest settings/capture ceiling and complete story DLC access.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows Ultimate Edition or the base Windows game plus Atomic Pass/all story DLC. Patch fully before capture, then verify graphics options and input behavior with community-style compatibility checks.
